settings.title: Webzine Board Add-on
settings.description: Choose how webzine board lists render posts that have no thumbnail.
settings.notice: These settings apply to the list screen of every board using the webzine type. Posts that do have a thumbnail are unaffected.
settings.upload_success: Image uploaded. Press Save below to apply it.

preview.title: Current Fallback Image
preview.empty: No fallback image yet. Upload one below or enter a URL.
preview.note: In the list it is cropped to a square (center-cropped).

no_thumbnail_mode.label: When No Thumbnail
no_thumbnail_mode.hint: How to render list rows for posts with no image to build a thumbnail from.
no_thumbnail_mode.summary_note: The thumbnail area is not rendered at all, so the title and summary use the full row width.
no_thumbnail_mode.placeholder_note: Shows a grey box with an image icon and a "No image" label.
no_thumbnail_mode.image_note: Shows the image configured below in place of the thumbnail.

fallback_source.label: Fallback Image Source
fallback_source.hint: Whether to upload the fallback image to this site or point at an existing image URL.

fallback_upload.label: Fallback Image File
fallback_upload.hint: PNG, JPG, WEBP or GIF, up to 2MB. SVG is not allowed for security reasons. The file uploads as soon as you pick it; press Save below to actually apply it.
fallback_upload.replace_note: Uploading a new image and saving cleans up the previous file automatically and takes effect for visitors right away.

fallback_image_url.label: Fallback Image URL
fallback_image_url.hint: Enter an https:// or http:// address, or a site-internal path starting with /.
fallback_image_url.warning: With an external address, the fallback image breaks too if the original is deleted or changed. In that case the row falls back to summary only.

fallback_alt.label: Alt Text
fallback_alt.hint: Text announced where the image cannot be seen (screen readers, etc.). Defaults to the site name when left empty.

design.random_section_hint: Shown only on the first list page on screens 768px wide or more. Hidden while searching or filtering by category.

list_width_mode.label: List Width
list_width_mode.note: Below 768px the list is always 100% of the screen width.
